doc.title: Bobby Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997

title: Rick Fay
summary: Gordon met Rick Fay only in the last 10 or 15 years and recorded with him.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: That’s interesting and I was also looking at this, you had quite an association with Rick Fay.

Rick Fay, yes. I didn’t get a chance to meet him until the last 10 or 15 years. I didn’t know him before, but I got a chance to record with him and he’s responsible for getting me on some records and things like that. Great tenor player and soprano and clarinetist.
